resolved_conflicts.explanation: EverybodyWiki's introduction says the tower was built on the mountain in 1932, but its history section says 1928 on Mount Irvine, then moved to Science Hill in 1932. The history section matches the New York chapter's 1932 move date, so the story follows it.

notes_for_editor: The move to the school is disputed: 1978 (NYSFLA list, EverybodyWiki's Wikipedia text) against the early 1970s (Hamilton College, citing a 2005 ASPFTRC webpage that was not read). The EverybodyWiki introduction gives 1932 for building on the mountain, which conflicts with its own history section; the story follows the history. A search summary placed the Mount Irvine to Science Hill move in 1931 (Mount Irvine article, not read), so 1931 is unverified and left out. Assumes the Ellicottville CTE School (Forest Lookouts) and the Ellicottville BOCES school (NYSFLA, EverybodyWiki) are the same site; no source says so outright. No source describes the current condition, public access, or a photo of the reassembled tower. The record has no height; the 18 m figure is for the original Mount Irvine tower and is not applied to the current structure.
